    AI Overview
    For its 51st season (2025–2026), Saturday Night Live features a mix of veteran stars and new talent, with Kenan Thompson returning for a record-breaking 23rd season. Key returning cast includes Bowen Yang, Chloe Fineman, Mikey Day, and Weekend Update anchors Colin Jost and Michael Che. Several new featured players joined in late 2025. 
    Key 2025-2026 Season 51 Cast & Changes: 
    • Returning Veterans: Kenan Thompson, Bowen Yang, Chloe Fineman, Mikey Day, Colin Jost, Michael Che, Marcello Hernández, Andrew Dismukes, James Austin Johnson, Sarah Sherman, Jane Wickline, Ashley Padilla.
    • New Featured Players (Joined Season 51):
      Ben Marshall (formerly of Please Don't Destroy), Tommy Brennan, Jeremy Culhane, Kam Patterson, and Veronika Slowikowska.
    • Departures: Heidi Gardner and Ego Nwodim departed after lengthy runs, along with Devon Walker, Michael Longfellow, and Emil Wakim.
    • Production Changes: John Higgins (of Please Don't Destroy) exited to pursue other projects, while Ben Marshall joined the main cast. 
    New episodes in early 2026 have highlighted cast members alongside notable hosts like Colman Domingo and musical guests like Noah Kahan.
